mapper.sql: SELECT T.TOC_SN AS tocSn, T.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, T.UP_TOC_SN AS upTocSn, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq, T.PIC_ID AS picId, U.USER_NM AS picNm, T.EXPC_PAGE_CNT AS expcPageCnt, T.PRGRS_STTS_CD AS prgrsSttsCd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR R WHERE R.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS rqtCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC C WHERE C.UP_TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS childCnt, LEVEL - 1 AS depth FROM TB_TOC T LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.PIC_ID
mapper.select: WHERE T.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} START WITH T.UP_TOC_SN IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR T.TOC_SN = T.UP_TOC_SN ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.SORT_SEQ, T.TOC_SN
WHERE T.PBANC_SN IS NULL START WITH T.UP_TOC_SN IS NULL AND T.PBANC_SN IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR T.TOC_SN = T.UP_TOC_SN ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.SORT_SEQ, T.TOC_SN

SELECT T.TOC_SN AS tocSn, T.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, T.UP_TOC_SN AS upTocSn, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq, T.PIC_ID AS picId, T.EXPC_PAGE_CNT AS expcPageCnt, T.PRGRS_STTS_CD AS prgrsSttsCd FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TOC (PBANC_SN, UP_TOC_SN, TOC_NO, TOC_NM, SORT_SEQ, PIC_ID, EXPC_PAGE_CNT, PRGRS_STTS_CD) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{upTocSn}, #{tocNo}, #{tocNm}, #{sortSeq}, #{picId}, #{expcPageCnt}, 'TS010')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TOC SET TOC_NM = #{tocNm}, EXPC_PAGE_CNT = #{expcPageCnt} WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
UPDATE TB_TOC SET EXPC_PAGE_CNT = #{expcPageCnt} WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
UPDATE TB_TOC SET TOC_NO = #{tocNo} WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC WHERE UP_TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RQT_MTTR SET TOC_SN = NULL WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
UPDATE TB_QSTN_ANS SET TOC_SN = NULL WHERE TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
